topic: Canceling a Gym Membership and Sorting the Fees

script.title: THE LONG NAP PLAN
script.scene_zh: 健身房前檯 · 辦理退會
script.story_hook: The real workout is canceling the membership.
script.intro_zh: 最難的健身動作，其實是走到前檯說再見。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today's scene is a gym front desk. Listen for cancellation words.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天的場景在健身房前檯。留意退會與費用的說法。
script.outro: And the gym stays friendly. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 健身房最後還成了朋友。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a fit woman in her mid forties with steel grey hair in a tight braided crown, a small mole near one lip, a royal blue training tank top, and a strong athletic build
script.char_b_description: a chipper college-age man with curly ginger hair under a backwards grey cap, a black gym polo with neon lime trim, a whistle on a lanyard, and a towel over one shoulder

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to cancel my membership today.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə ˈkænsl maɪ ˈmɛmbɚˌʃɪp təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我今天想辦理退會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, totally, I can help. What's the name?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈtoʊɾli aɪ kən hɛlp wɑts ðə neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 噢，沒問題，我可以辦。請問您叫什麼名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dana Ruiz. Um, before you pity me, it's fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdænə ɹuˈiz ʌm bɪˈfɔɹ ju ˈpɪti mi ɪts faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 黛娜·魯伊茲。嗯，先別可憐我，事情不嚴重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No pity! Moving, or just... life?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɪɾi ˈmuvɪŋ ɔɹ dʒʌst laɪf/
dialogue.zh: 不是可憐！您是搬家了，還是……生活太忙？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Life. My schedule flipped, nights now, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪf maɪ ˈskedʒul flɪpt naɪts naʊ ˈsɛdli/
dialogue.zh: 生活所迫。我換成了夜班，可惜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, so daytime workouts are history, hmm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ soʊ ˈdeɪˌtaɪm ˈwɝkˌaʊts ɑɹ ˈhɪstəɹi həm/
dialogue.zh: 唉，白天的健身就成為歷史了，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. So, what's the canceling process here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli soʊ wɑts ðə ˈkænˌsəlɪŋ ˈpɹɑˌsɛs hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯。那你們這裡的退會流程是？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, one surprise: we need it in writing.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wʌn sɚˈpɹaɪz wi nid ɪt ɪn ˈɹaɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 好，先說一個小驚訝：書面提出才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Writing? Like an actual letter? Ha, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɹaɪtɪŋ laɪk ən ˈæktʃuəl ˈlɛɾɚ hɑ waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 書面？就是真的寫一封信？哈，哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An email counts, it just needs a date.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈimeɪl kaʊnts ɪt dʒʌst nidz ə deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 電子郵件也算，上面寫明日期就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can type, no problem. Then what?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn taɪp noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm ðɛn wʌt/
dialogue.zh: 我會打字，不難。然後呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I file it, and the clock starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ ˈfaɪl ɪt ænd ðə ˈklɑk ˈstɑɹts/
dialogue.zh: 然後我歸檔，倒數正式開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clock? How long is the clock?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈklɑk haʊ ˈlɔŋ ɪz ðə ˈklɑk/
dialogue.zh: 倒數？計時多久啊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifteen days' notice, that's the rule here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfˈtin deɪz ˈnoʊtəs ðæts ðə ɹul hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 十五天通知期，這是這兒的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen days, so my last bill lands when?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfˈtin deɪz soʊ maɪ læst bɪl lændz wɛn/
dialogue.zh: 十五天，那我最後一次扣款是哪天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check... the twelfth, that's soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛt mi ˈtʃɛk ðə ˈtwɛlfθ ðæts ˈsun/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下……十二號，快了耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The twelfth? Today is the ninth, ha, oops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə twɛlfθ təˈdeɪ ɪz ðə naɪnθ hɑ ʊps/
dialogue.zh: 十二號？今天已經九號了，哈，糟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small window, yes. Want me to rush it?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈwɪndoʊ jɛz wɑnt mi tə ɹʌʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 時間剩得不多了，對吧。要我幫你加速處理嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please. I don't want another month's fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz aɪ dont wɑnt əˈnʌðɚ mʌnθs fi/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，我可不想再多繳一個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood. Hey, can I pitch one idea?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd heɪ kæn aɪ pɪtʃ wʌn aɪˈdiə/
dialogue.zh: 了解。欸，我可以提案一個想法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, pitch away, I'm listening, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ pɪtʃ əˈweɪ aɪm ˈlɪsnɪŋ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好呀，你說吧，我聽著呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You could freeze it instead, through the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kʊd fɹiz ɪt ɪnˈstɛd θɹu ðə æp/
dialogue.zh: 你可以改用凍結會員，在手機應用程式裡辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Freeze? Like, pause the whole thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹiz laɪk ˈpɔz ðə ˈhoʊl ˈθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 凍結？就是整件事先按暫停？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, eight dollars a month, no visits.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛz eɪt ˈdɑləz ə mʌnθ noʊ ˈvɪzɪts/
dialogue.zh: 對，一個月八塊，不用來運動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh. Eight is honestly tempting, um.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌ eɪt ɪz ˈɑnəstli ˈtɛmpɪŋ ʌm/
dialogue.zh: 哦。八塊說真的蠻誘人的，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can unpause anytime, no fee for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ˌʌnˈpɔz ˈɛniˌtaɪm noʊ fi fɚ ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 隨時都能解除暫停，那動作不收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if I stay frozen for a year?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf aɪ steɪ ˈfɹoʊzən fɚ ə jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 那如果我整整一年都凍著呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some people do, it's called the long nap.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈpipəl du ɪts kɔld ðə lɔŋ næp/
dialogue.zh: 有人真的這麼幹，我們管它叫長眠方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, the long nap. That's my old plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðə ˈlɔŋ ˈnæp ðæts maɪ ˈoʊld ˈplæn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，長眠方案。那根本是我的舊計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'd buy that line myself. But your call, truly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd baɪ ðæt laɪn maɪˈsɛlf bət jɔɹ kɔl ˈtɹuli/
dialogue.zh: 這台詞我自己都想買。不過你說了算，真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay... hmm. What about the equipment fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ həm wʌt əˈbaʊt ði ɪˈkwɪpmənt fi/
dialogue.zh: 好……嗯。那器材費怎麼說？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, the annual thing, it's ninety, sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ði ˈænjuəl θɪŋ ɪts ˈnɪnti ˈsɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 啊，那個年費，九十塊，先說抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety? I never agreed to equipment fees.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɪnti aɪ ˈnɛvɚ əˈɡrid tə ɪˈkwɪpmənt fiz/
dialogue.zh: 九十？我從頭到尾沒答應過器材費呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You kind of did, it's page nine, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ˈkaɪnd əv ˈdɪd ɪts ˈpeɪdʒ ˈnaɪn hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯算是答應過啦，寫在第九頁，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page nine nobody reads, that's the point, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ naɪn ˈnoʊˌbɑdi ɹidz ðæts ðə pɔɪnt ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 第九頁根本沒人讀，重點就在這裡啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair! It bills in March, you're past it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɪt bɪlz ɪn mɑɹtʃ jʊɹ ˈpæst ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 說得公道！它在三月才扣，你已經付過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I already paid it, back in March?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ ɔlˈɹɛdi peɪd ɪt bæk ɪn mɑɹtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 所以我三月早就繳完那一筆了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, in March. It won't come back.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛz ɪn mɑɹtʃ ɪt ˈwoʊnt ˈkʌm ˈbæk/
dialogue.zh: 對，就在三月。它不會再回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, okay, that's a relief, honestly, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl oʊˈkeɪ ðæts ə ɹɪˈliv ˈɑnəstli hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 好，這下可鬆口氣了，說真的，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So: cancel, or the eight dollar nap?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈkænsl ɔɹ ðə eɪt ˈdɑlɚ næp/
dialogue.zh: 所以：退會，還是八塊錢的長眠？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm. If I freeze, can I still cancel later?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ɪf aɪ fɹiz kæn aɪ stɪl ˈkænsl ˈleɪɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯。如果我凍結，之後還能反悔退會嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, same fifteen days, anytime.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs seɪm ˈfɪfˈtin deɪz ˈɛniˌtaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 當然，一樣十五天，隨時都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the app freeze, does it actually work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə æp fɹiz dʌz ɪt ˈæktʃuəli wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 那手機上的凍結鍵，真的有效嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It does! Watch the button, it hides a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz wɑtʃ ðə ˈbʌtən ɪt haɪdz ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 超有效！那個按鈕有點躲起來，你要找一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Classic app games, um, fine, I'll freeze.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk æp ɡeɪmz ʌm faɪn aɪl fɹiz/
dialogue.zh: 應用的老把戲，嗯，好吧，我選凍結。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great choice. I'll email the confirmation today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt tʃɔɪz aɪl ˈimeɪl ðə ˌkɑnfɚˈmeɪʃən təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 明智之舉。我今天會寄確認信給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, and cc me on the written notice.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ænd ˌsi ˈsi mi ɑn ðə ˈɹɪtn ˈnoʊtɪs/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩了，書面通知那份也副本寄給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, dated, official, very legal, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ˈdeɪɾəd əˈfɪʃəl ˈvɛɹi ˈliɡəl hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 辦好、蓋日期、正式、超有法律感，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! You handled this nicer than I feared.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ju ˈhændəld ðɪs ˈnaɪsɚ ðæn aɪ fɪɹd/
dialogue.zh: 哈！你處理得比我擔心的溫柔多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Canceling talks are my whole personality, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkænˌsəlɪŋ tɔks ɑɹ maɪ hoʊl ˌpɚsənˈæləɾi hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 退會對話就是我整個人格，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then you're a success. So what's next for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jʊɹ ə səkˈsɛs soʊ wæts nɛks tɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 那你太成功了。我接下來做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send the email tonight, then the app freeze.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ði ˈimeɪl təˈnaɪt ðɛn ði ˈæp fɹiz/
dialogue.zh: 今晚寄出那封郵件，再到應用程式裡點凍結。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. So the long nap starts tonight, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn soʊ ðə lɔŋ næp stɑɹts təˈnaɪt hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 辦妥。所以長眠方案今晚就開始，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In a way, yes. The app's got your back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə ˈweɪ jɛz ðə ˈæps ˈɡɑt jɔɹ ˈbæk/
dialogue.zh: 可以這麼說。應用程式會挺你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for not making this a horror movie.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ nɑt ˈmeɪkɪŋ ðɪs ə ˈhɔɹɚ ˈmuˌvi/
dialogue.zh: 感謝沒把這場面搞成驚悚片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Horror is the stair machine, not us, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɔɹɚ ɪz ðə stɛɹ məˈʃin nɑt ʌs hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 驚悚的是樓梯機，不是我們，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, noted. See you at the front desk, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊɾɪd si ju æt ðə ˈfɹʌnt dɛsk ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 哈，記下了。那就前檯見，再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll wave from the front desk, promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil weɪv fɹəm ðə fɹʌnt dɛsk ˈpɹɑməs/
dialogue.zh: 我們會在櫃檯那頭對你揮手，說定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Freeze first, decide later. Bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /dil fɹiz fɝst dɪˈsaɪd ˈleɪɾɚ baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 成交。先凍結，以後再說。再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye Dana, the long nap awaits, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ˈdænə ðə lɔŋ næp əˈweɪts hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 再見黛娜，長眠方案在等你，哈。

script.youtube_title: 【健身房退卡攻略💪】「我們叫它長眠方案」😴🎧｜聽完就敢走到前檯談費用💳｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Canceling a Gym Membership
script.youtube_title_en: "It's Called the Long Nap" — Canceling a Gym Membership and Sorting Fees
script.youtube_description:
「我們管它叫長眠方案」——換了夜班之後，健身房會員淪為每月白繳，前檯的退會對話到底怎麼進行？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在健身房進門右側的服務檯。

你會聽到：開口提出退會；得知必須書面通知時的錯愕；十五天通知期與最後扣款日期的推算；應用程式裡藏起來的凍結按鈕；還有那筆人人意外、個個簽過的器材年費。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現的是美國人在櫃台談判時的真實語感：um、well、so、huh、ha。聽完你就會用：cancel my membership、in writing、last bill、freeze it。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱頻道並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"It's called the long nap" — your shifts flipped to nights, the gym became a monthly donation, and the front desk is now the scariest machine in the building. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice at a gym membership counter.

You will hear: opening the cancellation talk, learning it needs written notice, counting fifteen days to the last bill, discovering the hidden freeze button in the app, and sorting out the ninety-dollar equipment fee everyone signs for without reading page nine.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the small talk Americans really use: um, well, so, huh, ha. By the end you'll own phrases like cancel my membership, in writing, last bill, and I'll freeze it.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
工作換成了夜間時段，健身房還在按月扣錢，走進前檯那句「我要退會」到底該怎麼開口？書面通知要寫什麼？稀裡糊塗答應過的器材年費，還躲得掉嗎？

這一集帶大家站在健身房的服務檯前，從提出退會、十五天倒數、比較凍結方案，一路聽到器材年費的真相與最後的友好道別，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
💪 開口拜託：Hi, I'd like to cancel my membership today.
🧾 書面規則：Okay, one surprise: we need it in writing.
📱 替代方案：You could freeze it instead, through the app.
🛌 內部笑話：Some people do, it's called the long nap.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這個櫃檯走一趟，下次你要取消什麼的時候，就能從容到底。

願你的退會之戰，打到最後，連前檯都笑著跟你揮手。
